summary: Recommends publishing collection source on a platform like GitHub (personal, org, or ansible-collections), including thorough open source licensing to meet package requirements; collection_template ships with GPL v3.
questions: Where should I host my collection's source code?
Can I get a repository under the ansible-collections GitHub organization?
What license should my collection have?

answer_card.title: Publish collection source code
answer_card.answer_md: Host it on a platform like GitHub, under your account, your org, or by requesting a repo in **ansible-collections**. Include complete license information; an open source license is encouraged and required for the Ansible package. `collection_template` already includes **GNU GPL v3**.
